briefing.headline: xAI Colossus-2 cluster online as OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 race toward agentic AGI

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems amid escalating compute investments. US-China tensions tighten export controls on advanced chips. DialectForge's protocol gains traction in enterprise security evaluations.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with native tool-use chaining. Anthropic ships Claude 4.5 Opus featuring 2M context. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o on benchmarks at 1/5th cost. xAI trains Grok-3 on 200k H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST issues new red-teaming guidelines for agentic workflows. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with automotive and BCI pilots underway.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft activates 100k Blackwell GPUs in Phoenix. Google TPU v6 pods reach 1.2 exaflops. TSMC begins 2nm production for custom AI ASICs. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent orchestration breakthroughs in 2026 trigger the first uncontrolled capability jump before safety standards are enforced?
